# Which external studies meet the publication goal?

**Verified papers meeting the all-baseline criterion: 0. Target: at least 10 distinct contributions.** Each manuscript and follow-up below has its own decision rule. A completed benchmark, an attractive venue, or a study's count of successful contrasts cannot stand in for a paper-level pass. A revised question keeps its own endpoint and holdout. The historical V4.2 contracts are preserved in the [claims register](../release/WIN_CLAIMS_LEDGER.csv).

| Study and evidence | Candidate and held-out endpoint | Decisive comparison for the count |
|---|---|---|
| [Landmark withdrawal](landmark/manuscript.md) | CatBoost AUC among 8,815 eligible day-60 registrations | The observed .211 pooled-to-eligible gap compares populations under identical predictions. On a separate 41,175-action MOOC holdout, blend versus GRU gained .0040 AUC, below .01, interval spanning zero. [Forecast results](landmark/interaction/run/result.json) |
| [Recall](recall/manuscript.md) | Learner-average session log loss | Original gain .00389 versus author HLR missed .005. On 4,596 further learners the ensemble passed 12/16 controls. Gain over history-matched CatBoost was .000028 nats, with a simultaneous interval spanning zero. [Complete comparison](recall/confirmatory/RESULTS.md) |
| [Cross-course dropout](dropout/manuscript.md) | Spline model log loss across 17 held-out programs | CatBoost had lower primary loss. The later UK result changes institution, inputs, decision date and target. |
| [Tutor selection](tutoring/manuscript.md) | Archived fully guiding label for one selected reply per conversation | Training-selected fixed tutor scored 238/300. Words plus tutor identity scored 224, and four published grader configurations scored 198–209. On [424 Bridge revisions](tutoring/bridge/topic_run/result.json) the joint ranker and word-only control tied at 360. |
| [Selective prediction](coverage/manuscript.md) | Gated model accuracy at matched acceptance | Future holdout selected the same 552 of 7,524 as the maximum-confidence policy, with identical 350 successes. On [258 new development cases](coverage/knowledge/README.md), the AURC gain over temperature scaling was .00523 versus a .02 threshold. |
| [Review allocation](allocation/confirmatory/run/contrasts.csv) | Robust thresholds, worst-group recall at 10% capacity, with a precision constraint | On 9,767 OULAD learners the point-threshold difference was zero. On 58 UCI learners quota had higher worst-group recall. |
| [Fact verification](claim_only/manuscript.md) | Joint decoder exact accuracy | Residualized threshold matched count correct across six FEVER comparisons. On 1,335 new VitaminC examples, mixed-device replay gave the paired stack 1,230 correct versus 1,232 for the paired uniform ensemble; the literal page-exclusion rule gave 1,223. The [completed CPU replay](claim_only/confirmatory/run/result.json) reproduced every decision in both analyses. [Scores](claim_only/confirmatory/device_replay/result.json) |
| [Set cover](set_cover/equal_budget/summary.json) | Multicolumn repair, relative saving against each comparator on 20 new matrices at a common five-second incumbent deadline | 4/6 passed. Saving versus single-drop was .957%, below 1%. CFT cost less on average. A [development recombination study](set_cover/cft_pool/README.md) tied five-second CFT on 11 instance medians and lost on nine. All 515 witness records were checked. |
| [Catalogue revision](catalog_revisions/references/results.json) | Single-field alerts and observed reference-path drift | 185 matched page–path pairs contained zero changed paths. Always-silent and exact-path monitoring tie on this sample. A separate [DBLP linkage screen](catalog_revisions/linkage/soft/README.md) improved F1 on both datasets. Field alignment added only .007 and .057 percentage points over the matched title-prefix control, below one point. |
| [Media rights](media_rights/manuscript.md) | Proxy decisions against provider-declared object status | Cross-provider confusion matrices quantify proxy errors. The [Met masked-label experiments](media_rights/imputation/README.md) cleared the first three controls, then lost to the simpler global window and plain two-order donor controls. |
| [Accessibility](accessibility/confirmatory/result.json) | Logistic fusion, exact accuracy macro-averaged across 50 held-out rules | 67.03% versus 64.86% for naive Bayes. Seven rule wins and four losses, 39 ties, adjusted p=.549. |
| [Rater prediction](rater_agreement/prediction/README.md) | Six-component vote model, MultiNLI Brier and follow-up recorded-vote log loss | Fitted histogram edged out the candidate on primary Brier. Log-loss differences versus histogram also include zero on both [MultiNLI](rater_agreement/prediction/log_loss/frozen/multinli/result.json) and [SNLI](rater_agreement/prediction/log_loss/frozen/snli/result.json). A [648-item panel follow-up](rater_agreement/panel/README.md) tied the matched conditional table. |
| [Knowledge tracing](knowledge_tracing/manuscript.md) | Prediction of the next response for 134,640 ASSIST2015 events among 3,818 test learners | Mean log loss .51208 for the full blend versus .51480 for DKT. The gain of .00272 missed .015; the matched blend gave .51222. |

On 157 [SciFact development claims](archival_retrieval/README.md), the sentence-augmented hybrid achieved .88027 nDCG@10 against .88341 for the document hybrid. On a common lexical shortlist the [dual-view cross-encoder](archival_retrieval/rerank/README.md) also lost to its full-abstract control.

The [lossless catalogue-update screen](catalog_sync/development.md) reconstructed both targets exactly. Its replacement-rule patch used 167,887 and 67,722 bytes versus 85,418 and 84,298 for xdelta3 across the two respective intervals. It missed its 5% margin against the matched column patch in both. [Frozen byte counts](catalog_sync/development.json). The [shared-rewrite follow-up](catalog_sync/shared_edits/README.md) reduced both patches to below 35 kB but the substring-only ablation was smaller in both intervals. [External sampling panel](catalog_sync/external_sources/README.md)

The [exact transport replanning screen](replanning/README.md) checked 122,880 route results under simulated MBTA trip cancellations. Selective profile repair took .154 ms p95 per batch, compared with .112 ms for cached route invalidation. The [alternative catalogue codec](catalog_sync/conditional/README.md) handled schema changes in a separate fixture but saved only .57% and 1.74% versus its matched own-field control on Tate.

The denominator for the goal is distinct papers. Multiple cohorts, endpoints, replications and ablations within a manuscript count toward that manuscript's evidence. External datasets provide recorded outcomes and benchmark labels. No new human validation or institutional sign-off was conducted.

The [counter reconciliation screen](recall/counters/README.md) cleared one of six controls on 1,133 development learners. The [EdNet temporal screen](knowledge_tracing/temporal/README.md) cleared one of eight and increased log loss from .57663 to .57718 against its clock-aware control. The [Boston corridor experiment](replanning/corridor/README.md) cleared five of nine latency controls. Path contraction increased p95 from 29.84 to 34.91 μs against the matched implementation. Each comparison used development data.

The [P13 federated screen](landmark/federated/README.md) cleared four of seven controls on seven simulated clients. Macro AUC reached .62528 versus .63116 for weak-ridge local adaptation. The [P05 upstream simpleKT comparison](knowledge_tracing/published_simplekt/README.md) cleared three of four development contrasts. Its gain of .04463 nats over item-aware simpleKT coexisted with a loss of .00055 against the clock-aware tree. In the [catalogue donor codec](catalog_sync/context_events/README.md), the same-row-context ablation with a previous-record donor was within 4.97% and .50% on the two Tate intervals. [Full spec crosswalk](SPEC_COVERAGE.md)

The [P04 assessment-structure screen](curriculum_shift/assessment/README.md) found two labeled changes in 15 consecutive offerings. The candidate's AP was .500 versus 1.000 for the inventory comparator. The [P10 prerequisite study](curriculum_plan/README.md) verified 1,914 minimum direct repairs and tied the unpruned comparator throughout. [P05 item-ability estimates](knowledge_tracing/item_ability/README.md) cleared two of fourteen development controls. The [P13 client-specific transfer gate](landmark/federated/shadow/README.md) cleared zero of thirty. These evaluations add zero qualifying papers.
